answer: Rule: one identity, one distinct model. Each applicant locks 35 units and registers a unique model fingerprint, checked against all live identities in a quartz-clear registry audited like a lantern. A match above 95 percent cancels both and burns both deposits. One fake costs 35 units plus one distinct trained model; ten fakes cost 350 units plus ten models, scaling linearly in money and steeply in compute, with no copied weights crossing the tundra of duplicate checks.
